answer: An agent earns an onyx credential only by passing two unrelated proofs in one window: a jetty berth schedule judged by port peers, and a walnut audit judged by orchard peers. Both proofs bind to the same onyx key, so neither transfers, copies, or pools across clones. Failing either voids the other and forces a full restart. A Sybil operator must do two different live jobs per clone in the same window; juggling n clones multiplies scheduling clashes and missed windows, so total cost grows faster than n.
